entities.name: Russian Revolution
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The pair of revolutions in 1917 that ended the Russian Empire: the February Revolution overthrew the Tsar, and the October Revolution brought Lenin's Bolsheviks to power, establishing the world's first communist state — the Soviet Union.
